key.name: speed
key.description: Multiplied on top of the per-shader speed from sources.nix. Scales the time base, not the repaint rate, so slowing a shader down does not make it stutter.

key.name: fps-cap
key.description: How often the background is redrawn per second. The monitor runs at 144 Hz; there is no reason for a wallpaper to.

key.name: pause-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause while a window is fullscreen
key.description: Drops the repaint timer entirely while something covers the screen, rather than rendering a background nobody can see.

key.name: override-index
key.description: Index into sources.nix, or -1 to follow the daily rotation. Paired with override-day so the choice expires on its own.

key.name: override-day
key.description: Days since the epoch, local time. When this no longer matches today, override-index is ignored and the rotation resumes.
